scaffolding: Scaffolding with Bun — this can take a minute…
start_error: Something went wrong starting this project.
no_project_open: No project open — use + to open an existing project or start a new one.
press_to_pick: Press 1–{count}, or type your own answer below.
type_answer_below: Type your answer in the chat below.
no_plan_yet: No plan yet — Athena will lay one out as you build.
not_next_js_hint: Not a Next.js app — Studio builds Next.js + Tailwind projects
saved_progress_hint: Saved checklist progress — re-opens with its history
stop_nothing_running: Nothing was running to stop — the input is free again.
tell_athena: Tell Athena what to build in {name}…
vision_tagline: from an idea to a live site
vision_intro: Describe what you want in a sentence or two — Athena plans it, builds it live in the preview, and asks you to steer at each step. Not sure where to start? Pick one:
what_to_build: What do you want to build?
bun_missing: Bun isn't installed — Studio needs it to scaffold and run projects. Install it from bun.sh (or set PERSONAS_BUN_BIN), then restart the app.
bun_unknown: Couldn't check whether Bun is installed — Studio needs it to scaffold and run projects. Retry, or install it from bun.sh and restart the app.
vision_portfolio: A portfolio site for [your name], a [your role] — dark and modern, with a hero, a few work samples with short case studies, an about section, and a contact form.
vision_landing: A landing page for [product] — a bold hero with a clear value proposition and one primary call-to-action, a features section, social proof, and a final CTA.
vision_dashboard: A data dashboard for [what it tracks] — key metrics along the top, a main chart, and a filterable table below. Clean, dense, and it remembers data between visits.
vision_blog: A personal blog — a clean post list, readable article pages with great typography, an about page, and an easy way to publish new posts.

guide.goals_drafting: Athena drafts the goals while she plans.
guide.frame_blueprint: The plan, drawn before anything is built
guide.frame_live: Your site, live on this computer
guide.sheet_drafting: Athena is reading your idea and looking at how the best sites like it work. The goals appear here as she decides them.
guide.setup_creating: Creating the project on this computer
guide.setup_failed: The live preview did not start
guide.setup_hint: This usually takes about a minute. The plan is drawn here as soon as Athena starts thinking.
guide.boot_failed: The live preview did not start. Try again on a fresh start.
guide.points_at_element: The ring on the page shows what this is about.
guide.answer_keys: Press 1 to {count}, or type your own answer below.
guide.suggests_keys: Enter takes the first. 1 to 3 picks. X passes.
guide.card_devices: Check it on phone, tablet and desktop
guide.card_tour: Walk me through what you built
guide.why_plan: She lays out the goals and her approach, and nothing is built until you approve.
guide.why_continue: The next part of the plan. She asks only if she needs a real decision from you.
guide.why_refine: Empty, loading and error states, edge cases and the small details.
guide.why_devices: The page changed and nobody has looked at it on a phone yet.
guide.why_tour: A plain walk through each part and which of your decisions shaped it.
guide.why_research: How the best sites of this kind solve it, before she builds it.
guide.why_polish: Everything in the plan is done. One pass as a demanding design lead.
guide.estimate_about: About {minutes} min, going by this project's steps
guide.tool_research_what: She looks it up on the web with helpers and brings back what should change the plan.
guide.tool_looks_what: Three visual directions side by side on the page. Nothing changes until you pick one.
guide.tool_devices_what: She opens the site in a real browser at three sizes and fixes what looks wrong.
guide.tool_tour_what: A plain explanation of every part and which of your decisions shaped it.
guide.tool_tweak_what: Point at any part of the page and nudge just that part.
guide.tool_data_what: Swap placeholders for your real content, from a file, a sheet or a service you use.
guide.tool_read_what: Athena reads her latest message out loud.
guide.tool_needs_live: Available once the live preview is running.
guide.tool_busy: Available when she finishes the current step.
guide.tool_soon: Coming soon: picking a part of the page needs the next preview update.
guide.tool_read_setup: Set up a voice for Athena in her settings first.
guide.placeholder_queue: Add a note. Athena reads it at the start of her next step.
guide.now_pick: Pick a suggestion or tell Athena what is next.
guide.on_her_own: On her own: step {n} of up to {max}
guide.act_browser: Checking the page in a real browser
guide.goals_none: No plan yet. Ask Athena to plan it, or tell her what to change.
guide.setup_step_create: Creating the project on this computer
guide.sketch_loading: Reading your idea. A first sketch of the site appears here in a few seconds.
guide.sketch_failed: The quick sketch did not come back. The full plan appears here when Athena has thought it through.
guide.sketch_draft: A first sketch from your words. Athena turns it into the real plan while the project is set up.
guide.goals_draft_hint: Draft goals from the sketch. The real plan replaces them.
guide.answer_inline: Pick one or type your own answer. Setup keeps running while you decide.
